name: What is the benefit of a design-build approach for a custom bathroom remodel compared to hiring separate contractors?

mainEntity.name: What is the benefit of a design-build approach for a custom bathroom remodel compared to hiring separate contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing our integrated design-build approach for your custom bathroom remodel provides a single point of coordination, streamlining the entire project from concept to completion. This contrasts with managing separate designers and contractors, which can lead to miscommunications, delays, and cost overruns. Our unified team ensures design vision and construction execution are harmonized, offering a managed process that prioritizes efficiency, clear communication, and accountability.
acceptedAnswer.description: A design-build approach offers a single point of coordination, unifying design and construction to prevent miscommunication and delays compared to separate contractors.
